name: github-repo-analyzer
description: Read-only repository analysis: architecture map, dependency graph with cycle and fan-in/fan-out insights, manifest dependency extraction, repo health signals, and heuristic code-review findings. Accepts a local path, GitHub/Git URL (including /tree/<ref>/<subdir> branch and monorepo links), or owner/repo[@ref] shorthand. Produces report.md, compact summary.json, full report.json, and an architecture.mmd Mermaid graph.
short_description: Read-only architecture, dependency, and heuristic code-review report for any repo.
disclaimers: Findings are unverified heuristic pattern/AST matches, not confirmed vulnerabilities or bugs. Verify each item in context before acting.
No repo code, tests, package managers, static analyzers (mypy, ESLint, Semgrep, CodeQL), CVE scanners, or taint analysis are executed. Dependency CVEs are not reported.

Import resolution is heuristic: Python uses ast.parse; JS/TS (with heuristic tsconfig.json/jsconfig.json baseUrl and paths alias resolution), Go, Rust, and Java use conservative regex. Dynamic imports, complex workspace overrides, Go multi-file packages, and Rust macros can be missed.
"Unreachable from entry points" does not mean dead code. Tests, plugins, library APIs, and framework-discovered modules frequently appear in this bucket.
Dependency analysis is manifest-based. Transitive dependencies and lockfile resolution are not included.

trial.description: Free run against public repos up to 500 files. Full analysis requires purchase.

network.purpose: shallow git clone/refresh of the target repository when the input is a URL or owner/repo shorthand; local-path inputs use no network

highlights: Architecture map: languages, manifests, entry points, module counts, and internal dependency edges.
Mermaid dependency graph (architecture.mmd) with entry points, cycle participants, hub modules, high fan-out modules, and isolated modules color-coded.
Graph metrics & insights: full-repo and production-only subgraph metrics (SCCs, cycles, fan-in/fan-out, reachability), plus high-churn production hubs on non-shallow git repos.

Manifest dependency extraction for pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pom.xml, build.gradle(.kts), Gemfile, composer.json, pubspec.yaml, and .csproj/.fsproj, plus OpenAPI/GraphQL/Protobuf/Next.js detection.

Repo health & onboarding signals: deterministic reading order, git HEAD & churn hotspots, env var surface (key names only), CI/Makefile/justfile/Taskfile/docker-compose commands, README/LICENSE, largest files, and read-only test detection.

AST-based Python sink detection, context-aware JS/TS/Go/SQL heuristics, scope separation (production vs test/example/docs), auto-redacted secret patterns, and guided read-only Context Triage with finding-driven follow-ups in SKILL.md.
Strictly read-only on the repository: never executes repo code or tests; writes only to WORK_ROOT and the output directory.

Accepts a local path, GitHub/Git URL (including /tree/<ref>/<subdir>, /blob/<ref>/<path>, and /commit/<sha>), or owner/repo[@ref] shorthand with --ref/--subdir flags, compact summary.json output, and environment overrides for WORK_ROOT, MAX_SIZE_MB, GIT_TIMEOUT, GITHUB_TOKEN, and MAX_FILES.

audience.primary: Developers evaluating an unfamiliar codebase before contributing, forking, or auditing.
audience.secondary: Engineering teams doing a first-pass architectural review or onboarding audit.

analysis_limitations: Python imports use ast.parse; JS/TS, Go, Rust, and Java imports use conservative regex patterns. Compiler-grade resolution is not performed.
No repo code or tests are executed; no static analysis (Semgrep, CodeQL, mypy, ESLint, ruff), no CVE scan (pip-audit, npm audit, OSV), and no taint analysis is run.
Dependency analysis is manifest-based; transitive dependencies and lockfile resolution are not included.
Entry-point detection is heuristic: conventional filenames, __main__ guards, main functions, package.json metadata/scripts, and pyproject.toml scripts.
Unreachability from detected entry points is not equivalent to dead code. Tests, plugins, library APIs, and framework-discovered modules frequently appear unreachable.

Bounded analysis: MAX_BYTES = 1 MB/file, MAX_ARCHITECTURE_BYTES = 32 MB/repo, MAX_FILES = 20 000 (configurable); findings truncated at 2 000. Truncations and skipped counts are disclosed in report.md and report.json.
Generated, vendored, binary, oversized, and sensitive files (.env, .env.*, private keys, credential files) are skipped without being read.
